description: Read-only import of gym-type workouts and heart rate from Health Connect (Android) and HealthKit (iPhone) as GymApp activity-only workouts. Source of truth for both clients.

rules.invalidRecord: Skip when the record id is empty, or when receiptKeyPrefix + recordId is longer than maxReceiptKeyLength UTF-16 code units, or when the record id contains a control character (Unicode category Cc: U+0000..U+001F and U+007F..U+009F). Checked first; such records never count toward sessionCap and are never given a receipt, so one malformed id cannot block a run.
rules.ownApp: Skip when the record's source package or bundle id is listed in the store's ownSourceIds. HealthKit also treats a `.`-suffixed variant of a listed bundle id (app extensions, the Apple Watch app) as own.
rules.notGymType: Skip when the record's exercise type is missing or not listed in the store's gymExerciseTypes.
rules.duration: durationSeconds = floor((endMillis - startMillis) / 1000). Skip when the interval is empty, inverted or outside the supported timestamp range, or when durationSeconds is below minDurationSeconds or above maxDurationSeconds.
rules.inProgress: Skip when endMillis is later than the run's start time nowMillis (the session is still running or lies in the future); a session that ends exactly at nowMillis is imported. It is picked up by a later run once it has ended.
rules.duplicateReceipt: Skip when receipts contains receiptKeyPrefix + recordId. Receipts are kept when the imported workout is deleted so it never returns on this install. Receipts are per install and per account: a reinstall, a second device or an account switch back starts without them and may import a workout that was deleted earlier again, as long as it is still inside the window.
rules.overlap: Existing interval is [startMillis, startMillis + (durationSeconds ?? 0) * 1000]. Skip when existingStart - tolerance <= sessionEnd and existingEnd + tolerance >= sessionStart, tolerance being overlapToleranceSeconds * 1000. Checked against every local workout of the account.
rules.sessionCap: At most maxSessionsPerRun sessions that pass own-app and not-gym-type are evaluated per run, newest start first; at most maxRecordsScannedPerRun records are read. Remaining sessions are reported as truncated, not skipped with a reason.
rules.heartRate: Samples with startMillis <= timeMillis <= endMillis and minPlausibleBpm <= bpm <= maxPlausibleBpm. averageHeartRate = sum / count rounded half up; maximumHeartRate = max. Both absent without samples.
rules.calories: gymCalories = kilocalories rounded half up to an integer when finite and within 0..maxKilocalories, else 0. A value of 0 adds no kcal note segment.
rules.workout: workoutStartedAt = startMillis; garminCalories and endingHeartRateZone are never set; note is notePrefix, type label, then the segments below joined by noteSeparator, each present only when its value is greater than 0. Duration shows as minutes:seconds with two-digit seconds; minutes are not capped at 59.
rules.window: Only sessions that start within the last windowDays days are read. Runs started automatically are skipped when the last completed run is newer than minAutoImportIntervalSeconds.
rules.accountOptIn: Health permission belongs to the app, not to a GymApp account, so every account opts in on its own. The per-account flag enabled is off by default. Connect = request the store permissions + set enabled; disconnect = clear enabled (revoking the store permission itself stays a UI action). A run for an account whose flag is off returns status notEnabled before it reads anything from the store, for automatic and manual triggers alike. Other accounts of the same install never import on its behalf.
rules.dataOrigin: Heart-rate samples and kilocalories are read only from the data origin (source app) that recorded the session itself, never from any other source. A session without a source id gets no heart rate and no kilocalories. Missing data stays missing; there is no fallback to other apps.
rules.heartRateBudget: At most maxHeartRateSamplesPerRun heart-rate samples are read per run, summed over all sessions. A session whose samples would cross the budget, and every later session of the run, is imported without heart rate (no partial average).

caseFormat.session: recordId, startMillis, endMillis, exerciseType (store-specific name or null), sourceId, kilocalories (number or null), heartRateSamples [{timeMillis, bpm}]
caseFormat.existingWorkouts: Every local workout of the account: startMillis and durationSeconds (null when unknown).
caseFormat.receipts: Receipt keys already stored for the account.
caseFormat.expected: outcome is 'imported' (with receiptKey and the stored workout fields) or 'skipped:<reason>'.
caseFormat.nowMillis: The run's start time in epoch milliseconds, used by the in-progress rule.
